critical.issue: Discount is only computed when coupon.type is 'percentage' or 'fixed'. For every other seeded/allowed type (flash_sale, seasonal, vip, first_time, birthday, bogo, free_shipping, referral) the server returns discount=0 and revenue=amount, even though discount_value is set. E.g. redeeming SUMMER25 (type=flash_sale, discount_value=25) with amount=100 returns {discount: 0, revenue: 100} instead of {discount: 25, revenue: 75}. The seed itself acknowledges this by computing 'disc = amt * val / 100 if typ in (percentage, flash_sale, seasonal, vip, first_time, birthday) else 0' but the runtime /redeem endpoint (server.py lines ~351-356) does not follow the same rule. This means the Redeem Sandbox in the UI on Top Campaigns like SUMMER25 will show $0 discount.

action_items: Fix POST /api/coupons/redeem discount calculation to handle every valid coupon.type (flash_sale, seasonal, vip, first_time, birthday, bogo, free_shipping, referral). Simplest: treat all percentage-like types as percentage of amount, free_shipping as fixed shipping cost or 0-discount but revenue=amount, bogo as ~50% off subject to product logic. At minimum align it with the discount formula used in the seed function.
Improve Redeem Sandbox UX: either disable the Redeem button when coupon.state!='active', or render an inline error in the result box on 400 explaining the state, instead of relying only on the toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/coupons/redeem discount branch does not cover all supported types (see critical bug).
server.py seed() runs only once (early-return if admin exists) — good for idempotency but any password change in .env won't propagate. Consider hashing-based update on startup.
No test-data cleanup: parallel test runs leave TEST_ prefixed coupons in the seeded workspace (grew from 7 -> 47 during this iteration). Consider a cleanup fixture or a dedicated TEST workspace.

UI redeem sandbox on a draft coupon returns a toast-only 400 — consider inline error.
rca of the issue: In server.py POST /api/coupons/redeem: `if c['type'] == 'percentage': discount = body.amount * c['discount_value'] / 100 elif c['type'] == 'fixed': discount = min(...); else: discount = 0`. The elif chain has no branch for other coupon types even though they carry discount_value (e.g. SUMMER25 has type=flash_sale, discount_value=25). Reproduction: login as owner, POST /api/coupons/redeem {code:'SUMMER25', amount:100, customer:'x'} -> 200 {ok:true, discount:0, revenue:100}. Mitigation: extend the elif to treat flash_sale/seasonal/vip/first_time/birthday as percentage, bogo as ~50% (or the intended business rule), free_shipping as 0 discount but perhaps a shipping-cost field, referral as fixed or percentage per business intent. Ideally mirror the formula used in the seed() function.
